methods.text: Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) Project Application Form (Alabama Department of Transportation (ALDOT), Office of Safety Operations, 12/18/2020 (Introduction tab)), Worksheet 2a, item 51 'Cost per Crash by Severity*', cells Q6-Y6; footnote B54 '* Cost data from the Alabama Department of Transportation (ALDOT)'

not available for Alabama: ALDOT's Safety Management Section supplies crash rates on request (HSIP report 2025); no statewide average-rate table was found in its public manuals, and CrashIQ has no Alabama traffic counts

Highway Safety Manual (AASHTO, 1st, 2010), Ch. 4, Sec. 4.2.3. Alabama's own method, ALDOT selects HSIP projects by benefit/cost (HSIP application, Worksheets 2a-3), isn't built: this report uses the HSM critical rate against the corridor's own sites (national method)
not available for Alabama: the HSIP application asks for the crash history at the site but its tabs found here set no minimum study period
